name: ANAPAL
author: strings-agent
description: MEDIUM. Palindromic anagram containing a required substring. Clue is 'LETTERS|W': LETTERS is a shuffled multiset (length 8-13, alphabet size 3-5) that is known to have a palindromic arrangement, and W (length 2-4) is a substring of one such arrangement. Solution: any string that is a palindrome, uses exactly the letters of LETTERS, and contains W. Scorer is four conjuncts (~110 chars). Solve: for each offset p, pin W at p and at its mirror, check consistency, then fill the free mirror-pairs from the leftover multiset with the odd-count letter in the centre; ~0.1 ms. Discovery path: a demo shows an answer that is visibly a palindrome and visibly the same letters as the part before '|'; the extra 'contains W' clause is the second step teams find after their palindromes start scoring 0 sometimes. Gradient: guessing only 'palindrome of those letters' already scores on the instances where the greedy palindrome happens to contain W.
generate:
def generate(seed):
    r = random.Random(seed)
    for _ in range(200):
        n = r.randint(8, 13)
        al = 'abcdefg'[:r.randint(3, 5)]
        half = [r.choice(al) for _ in range(n // 2)]
        pal = half + ([r.choice(al)] if n % 2 else []) + half[::-1]
        pal = ''.join(pal)
        L = r.choice([2, 3, 3, 4])
        if L > n - 1:
            continue
        p = r.randrange(0, n - L + 1)
        w = pal[p:p + L]
        letters = list(pal)
        r.shuffle(letters)
        letters = ''.join(letters)
        if letters == pal or (letters == letters[::-1] and w in letters):
            continue
        return letters + '|' + w
    return letters + '|' + w
